Dinner

Queso Chicken & Rice

Taco-seasoned chicken and basmati rice meet a creamy, tangy queso sauce built with Greek yogurt, cheddar and green chiles.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
35 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
8

Ingredients

  • 24 oz (680 g) chicken breast
  • 1½ tsp avocado oil
  • 1½ packets taco seasoning, approximate amount
  • 300 g dry basmati rice
  • Queso sauce: 250 g 2% plain Greek yogurt or blended cottage cheese; 85 g red enchilada sauce; 85 g pico de gallo; 85 g cheddar; 100 g light cream cheese; 65 g diced green chiles
  • 20 g nutritional yeast and 10 g brown sugar, optional
  • ½ tsp each garlic powder and onion powder; pinch of salt
  • Chopped cilantro, to finish

Amounts are scaled from 5 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Cook rice according to its package directions. Season chicken on all sides with taco seasoning.
  2. Heat avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken, turning as needed, until browned and the thickest part reaches 165°F (74°C). Rest briefly, then slice or dice.
  3. Blend Greek yogurt, enchilada sauce, pico, cheddar, cream cheese, green chiles, optional nutritional yeast and brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder and salt until smooth.
  4. Warm the queso sauce gently in a saucepan or microwave, stirring often. Do not boil; yogurt-based sauces can split if overheated.
  5. Divide rice and chicken among five containers. Spoon queso sauce over the top and finish with cilantro.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
